remarks: Stunning 2,208 sq ft home blending timeless style with modern function, featuring a rear-attached garage and charming covered front porch for standout curb appeal.   The bright front entry opens to a spacious great room with fireplace and nook, enhanced by an impressive open-to-below design that fills the home with natural light. The chef-inspired kitchen offers quartz counters, a large island with eating ledge and pendant lighting, Silgranit undermount sink, built-in microwave, custom hood fan with full-height backsplash, upgraded Thermofoil cabinetry with soft-close doors/drawers, and a generous butler’s pantry.   Main floor den with storage is ideal for a home office or playroom. Rear foyer, mudroom with garage access, half bath, and separate side entry add flexibility.   Upstairs features a primary suite with 5-pce ensuite and walk-in closet, plus bonus room, laundry, two additional bedrooms, and a 3-pce bath. Black fixtures, upgraded railings, and basement rough-in plumbing complete the home. (id:67522)
